T: Baked potatoes, mushroom stew and a chicken jockey.
D: Four misfits are pulled through a portal into the blocky Overworld and need Steve's help to get home.
P: Serve the drumsticks when the chicken jockey shows up.
S: Potatoes baked at 200C until the skins crisp, split open with butter, salt and chives.
Watermelon and rockmelon cut into neat even cubes and stacked into little blocks on a board, served very cold.
Choc chip cookie dough pressed into a tray, baked until just golden and cut into neat square blocks while warm.
M: the chicken jockey, a moment everyone remembers
Chicken drumsticks glazed with honey, chilli flakes and smoked paprika, roasted at 200C until sticky and charred at the edges.
crafted from red and brown mushrooms
Mixed mushrooms simmered with onion, garlic, thyme, stock and cream until thick, with crusty bread.
W: Spiced pumpkin custard in a shortcrust case, baked until just set and served with whipped cream.
K: Cold milk poured into big mugs, with a jug of chocolate syrup on the side for stirring in.

s.how: Prick 4 large potatoes, rub with oil and salt and bake at 200C for 70 minutes until the skins are crisp. Split open, press to fluff and fill each with butter (60g total), more salt and snipped chives.

Beat 125g butter with 150g brown sugar and 1 egg, then mix in 200g flour, 1/2 tsp bicarb and 150g chocolate chips. Press into a lined 20cm square tin and bake at 175C for 22 minutes. Cut into neat squares while warm.

m.note: the chicken jockey, a moment everyone remembers
m.how: Toss 12 chicken drumsticks with 4 tbsp honey, 1 tsp chilli flakes, 2 tsp smoked paprika, 2 tbsp oil and salt. Roast at 200C for 45 minutes, turning and basting twice, until sticky and charred at the edges.

w.how: Roast 600g pumpkin until soft and purée. Whisk with 395g condensed milk, 2 eggs, 2 tsp cinnamon and a pinch of nutmeg. Pour into a blind-baked shortcrust case and bake at 180C for 45 minutes until just set. Cool and serve with 200ml whipped cream.

d.how: Chill 1.2L milk well and pour into 4 big mugs. Put a jug with 125ml chocolate syrup on the table so everyone stirs in as much as they like.
